title.zh: 理想导体边界磁通修正

summary: Solve a truncated-SVD boundary-source system and add its Green correction to field-point flux. The named fields are returned in one scirel._result.Result mapping.

capability: Solve a truncated-SVD boundary-source system and add its Green correction to field-point flux.
operation: uncorrected field flux and Green matrices -> corrected flux and solve diagnostics
discovery.geometry: Finite field and boundary sample axes with explicit matrix shape compatibility.
discovery.boundary: Rank truncation controls the residual; incompatible or rank-deficient systems may retain a nonzero residual.

identity.direction: uncorrected field flux and Green matrices to corrected flux and solve diagnostics
identity.definition: Sample the field flux at the boundary, solve Gbb currents=-sampled_flux with a relative singular-value cutoff, and apply Gbf currents. The documented fields are returned together in a scirel._result.Result mapping; mapping and attribute access expose the same values. No nested mapping is returned.
identity.geometry: Finite field and boundary sample/source axes with explicit matrix shape compatibility.
identity.coordinates: Flux Wb/rad; Green responses Wb/rad/A; currents A.
identity.boundary: Rank truncation controls the residual; incompatible or rank-deficient systems may retain nonzero residual.
assumptions: All arrays are finite real values.
The boundary Green matrix is nonempty.
The correction is linear and carries no physical conductor model.

inputs.name: uncorrected_field_flux
inputs.description: Psi=R A_phi before boundary-source correction at caller-defined field points.
inputs.constraints: Finite one-dimensional vector; length equals the columns of boundary_sample_matrix and rows of green_boundary_to_field.

inputs.name: boundary_sample_matrix
inputs.description: Linear map from field flux to sampled boundary flux.
inputs.constraints: Finite two-dimensional matrix; column count equals N_field and row count equals green_boundary_to_boundary rows.

inputs.name: green_boundary_to_boundary
inputs.description: Psi response at boundary samples per unit boundary-source current.
inputs.constraints: Finite nonempty two-dimensional matrix; shares its source columns with green_boundary_to_field.

inputs.name: green_boundary_to_field
inputs.description: Psi response at field points per unit boundary-source current.
inputs.constraints: Finite two-dimensional matrix; row count equals N_field and column count equals N_source.

inputs.name: rcond
inputs.description: Relative cutoff for singular values of the boundary Green matrix.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; values above one are allowed and can retain no singular values.

outputs.name: corrected_field_flux
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Uncorrected field psi plus Gbf @ boundary_currents.

outputs.name: boundary_currents
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Equivalent source-current coefficients from the truncated pseudoinverse.

outputs.name: boundary_flux_correction
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Gbb @ boundary_currents at boundary samples.
outputs.constraints: Uses the boundary-sample order of Gbb.

outputs.name: field_flux_correction
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Gbf @ boundary_currents at field points.

outputs.name: singular_values
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Boundary Green singular values in descending order.
outputs.constraints: From the reduced SVD of Gbb.

outputs.name: effective_rank
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Count of singular values strictly above the relative cutoff.

outputs.name: residual
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Original sampled boundary psi plus boundary-source correction.
outputs.constraints: Equals S @ uncorrected_field_flux + Gbb @ boundary_currents; may be nonzero.

outputs.name: residual_norm
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Euclidean norm of the boundary residual.
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative; may be nonzero after truncation or incompatible boundary flux.

preconditions: All arrays are finite real values.
The boundary Green matrix is nonempty.
supported: Full-rank and truncated-SVD toy systems, returned diagnostics, and shape failures.
excluded: Nonlinear boundary physics, automatic regularization selection, and physical ideal-conductor validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError is raised for nonfinite, wrong-rank, incompatible, empty, or invalid-rcond inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Linear-algebra or floating-point failures propagate from the SVD and matrix products.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the solve is a single truncated-SVD operation.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No scirel._result.Result correction mapping is returned after validation or solve failure.

example.description: Solve a two-sample full-rank boundary correction.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel._result import Result
from scirel.field import correct_ideal_conductor_boundary_flux
psi = np.array([3.0, -1.0, 2.0])
sample = np.array([[1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.5, 0.5]])
gbb = np.diag([2.0, 4.0])
gbf = np.array([[2.0, 0.0], [-1.0, 3.0], [1.0, 5.0]])
assert np.allclose(sample @ gbf, gbb)
result = correct_ideal_conductor_boundary_flux(psi, sample, gbb, gbf)
assert isinstance(result, Result)
assert list(result) == [
    'corrected_field_flux', 'boundary_currents',
    'boundary_flux_correction', 'field_flux_correction',
    'singular_values', 'effective_rank', 'residual', 'residual_norm'
]
assert result.corrected_field_flux is result['corrected_field_flux']
np.testing.assert_allclose(
    result['corrected_field_flux'], [0.0, 0.125, -0.125]
)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['residual'], 0.0)
assert result['effective_rank'] == 2
example.expected: The corrected flux is [0,0.125,-0.125], effective_rank is 2, and the sampled residual is zero within floating-point tolerance. The returned object is a scirel._result.Result mapping; each field is also readable as an attribute.

scope: Full-rank cancellation and sampling-consistent corrected field flux.
Consistent 2*pi rescaling of the flux and both Green matrices preserves equivalent boundary currents.
Relative singular-value cutoff and effective rank.
The named result preserves the captured key order, values, shapes, dtypes, mapping access and attribute access; failures retain their exception types and messages.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests verify a small full-rank sampling-consistent system, one truncated-rank case and consistent 2*pi rescaling of all flux quantities. They do not verify arbitrary boundary Green data, conditioning guarantees, physical wall correctness or expert recognition of this development record.
known_limitations: The implementation checks matrix dimensions but does not check S @ Gbf = Gbb; callers must establish that physical coupling separately.
Truncation can leave a nonzero residual.
Rescaling only some flux ports is not a supported unit conversion; existing vacuum-field Wb labels and equilibrium-side Wb/rad conventions still require science-owner adjudication.
No geometric or source Green construction is included.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.
